product_one_liner.value: Vertical Insure provides vertical SaaS platforms with an embedded-insurance platform to offer carrier-backed coverage within their existing customer workflows, while managing policy administration, compliance, and claims.
product_one_liner.notes: The product page says the platform lets software platforms offer protection in existing customer experiences and provides carrier-backed products, policy administration, compliance, and claims operations.

pricing_page.notes: The public G2 pricing page for Vertical Insure describes its single pricing edition, pricing available upon request, and revenue-share model; a public pricing page counts even without public dollar amounts.

named_customers.notes: The G2 listing has user reviews but does not identify two customer organizations; the named organizations in its integrations section are partner platforms, which the question excludes. Therefore no qualifying named customers are supported.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn profile gives a company employee count of 53, which falls in the 51-100 band.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index’s listed posts are general customer, product, insurance, and market content by “ViAdmin”; it does not show two technical build posts authored by engineers, so this is not an engineering blog.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers index lists eight open positions across Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and Sales, with no AI, ML, data-science, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision job title.

model_provider.notes: The published case study states that Vertical Insure’s location-intelligence system was rebuilt using OpenAI models; this identifies OpenAI as a model provider used in a product workflow.
